fields.System.Title: TRF-5 — Network stock view
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Show what the whole network holds — on hand at each site plus everything on a lorry between
them.

Scope

In. A cross-warehouse availability and in-transit view.

Out. Network planning and rebalancing decisions.

Design notes

This is the clearest genuine case for a projection in the whole system. At multi-site scale
each warehouse may eventually run its own database, and a live cross-site aggregate query stops
being possible. Building it as a maintained view now means the shape does not have to change
later.

Three quantities per product per site, and they must be named precisely: on hand, available,
and in transit inbound. A single "stock" number across a network is the fastest route to
over-promising at two sites at once.

Refresh in minutes, not seconds. A planner deciding what to rebalance next week does not
need second-level freshness. Expose last_updated_at so they can see what they are looking at.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| In-transit counted as available at either site | [doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Projection drift across sites | [doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
| Staleness invisible to the planner | [doc 08 §5.3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
